## Группа Ассура 2–3

$\overline F_{21}=\overline F^n_{21}+\overline F^\tau_{21}$, $\overline F_{30}=\overline F^n_{30}+\overline F^\tau_{30}$.

$\sum\overline F^{(2,3)}=\overline F_{21}+\overline F_{30}+\overline F_{34}+\overline F_{25}+\overline G_2+\overline\Phi_2+\overline G_3+\overline\Phi_3=0$.

$\sum M_B=-F^\tau_{21}l_{AB}-F^\tau_{30}l_{BC}+F_{25}h_{F25}-\Phi_2h_{\Phi2}+F_{34}h_{F34}+M_{\Phi2}+M_{\Phi3}=0$.

## Проверка по звену 3

$\sum\overline F^{(3)}=\overline F_{30}+\overline F_{34}+\overline G_3+\overline\Phi_3+\overline F_{32}=0$.

$\sum M_B=-F^\tau_{30}l_{BC}+F_{34}h_{F34}-G_3h_{G3}+M_{\Phi3}=0$.
